name: Old Chinese
notes: STRUCTURAL ANCESTRY NODE (not a modelled G2P target). Old Chinese (c. 1250 BCE-220 CE) is the oldest attested stage of Sinitic and the ancestor of Middle Chinese. It exists so that the ancestry and phylogenetic-distance metrics of the modern varieties that reference it have a node to resolve to. It carries no grapheme table. Old Chinese is written in Chinese characters, which a letter table cannot model; a table needs a cited reconstruction, the romanization it is written in and the sound value of each symbol.

sources.author: Baxter, W. H. & Sagart, L.
sources.title: Old Chinese: A New Reconstruction
